title: DFX Design - Arch
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a member of the Computing \& Graphics (CG) Framework Architecture team, you will develop and design silicon for client, discrete graphics, and related platforms. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC architect to define future architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro\-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade\-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production.
   

  

 THE PERSON:
   

  

 In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem\-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues and SOC and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co\-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop next\-generation SoC debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring\-up, validation, and post\-silicon debug.
* Partner with architecture and SoC design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design\-for\-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end\-to\-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations.
* Evaluate and deploy AI\-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time\-to\-deployment.
* Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations.


**Preferred Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in SoC design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines.
* Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large\-scale SoC architectures.
* Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features.
* Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low\-power design architectures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives.
* Experience applying AI and data\-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization.
* Ability to leverage modern AI\-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks.


**Academic Credentials**
* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

**Job Description**
* We are looking for an experienced Oracle EPM Solution Architect to lead the architecture and design of complex, enterprise\-scale EPM solutions. The ideal candidate will have architect\-level expertise in Oracle Enterprise Planning/EPBCS or FCCS, along with a strong understanding of the broader Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem.
* You will work closely with Finance and IT stakeholders to understand business needs, define end\-to\-end solution architecture, and guide customers toward scalable, high\-performing, and maintainable solutions. This role requires a strong combination of functional Finance knowledge and technical EPM expertise, including application design, integrations, automation, performance, and workload management.
* As a trusted advisor and design authority, you will challenge requirements when appropriate, explain architectural trade\-offs, promote Oracle recommended practices, and provide technical leadership to implementation teams throughout the solution lifecycle.


**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
**About You** 
 :
   

  

* Experienced Oracle EPM Solution Architect with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex, enterprise\-scale EPM solutions.
* Architect\-level expertise in at least one of Oracle Enterprise Planning/EPBCS or FCCS, with a strong understanding of the broader Oracle EPM Cloud landscape.
* Strong functional and technical knowledge, with the ability to translate Finance requirements into scalable, high\-performing, and maintainable solutions.
* Good understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, Workforce and Capex Planning, Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and financial consolidation and close processes.
* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end EPM ecosystem, including ERP/HCM source systems, data and metadata flows, integrations, reporting, security, automation, and downstream systems.

* Understand EPM workload and performance management, including application and dimensional design, calculations, data loads, integrations, job scheduling, concurrency, and reporting workloads.
* Able to lead architecture workshops, establish solution standards, review complex designs, and provide technical direction to implementation teams.
* Stay current with Oracle EPM Cloud capabilities, quarterly updates, and recommended architecture and implementation practices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* BE, BTech, MCA, MBA in Finance, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
* 10\+ years of EPM experience, with significant experience implementing Oracle EPM Cloud solutions.
* Demonstrated experience as an EPM Solution Architect, Application Architect, or equivalent design authority on complex implementations.
* Architect\-level expertise in Oracle Enterprise Planning/EPBCS or FCCS, with working knowledge of other EPM capabilities such as ARCS, EDMCS, EPCM/PCMCS, and Narrative Reporting.
* Experience with at least three end\-to\-end EPM implementations, including architecture/design, build, integration, testing, deployment, and production transition.
* Strong functional knowledge of Finance processes, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and/or financial consolidation and close.
* Strong understanding of EPM application architecture, including dimensions, hierarchies, cubes, calculations, Groovy, security, reporting, and performance considerations.
* Strong knowledge of EPM integration and automation, including Data Integration, Integration Agent, Pipelines, REST APIs, EPM Automate, Groovy, and integration with Oracle Fusion and other enterprise systems.
* Hands\-on understanding of scripting technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Shell, or Batch.
* Ability to evaluate solution options and clearly communicate architecture decisions, trade\-offs, risks, performance implications, and maintainability.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to lead technical teams and work effectively with Finance, IT, enterprise architecture, integration, and customer leadership teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience architecting multi\-application Oracle EPM Cloud landscapes and integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP/HCM and other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of EDMCS, OAC, Essbase 19c/21c, Hybrid BSO/ASO, and multidimensional database concepts.
* Experience with large\-scale EPM implementations involving complex data volumes, organizational structures, currencies, and business processes.
* Experience conducting architecture assessments, performance reviews, health checks, and solution modernization.
* Experience leading architecture workshops, design reviews, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and mentoring EPM consultants and developers.
* Understanding of EPM Cloud operations, migrations, quarterly updates, production support, SRs, RFCs, and My Oracle Support.
* Relevant Oracle EPM Cloud certifications are preferred.
* Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to influence customer decisions and confidently recommend the right solution.

 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Infrastructure Cloud Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN\-TG), India (IN).
  
* Position Name: Infrastructure and Cloud Engineer
* Client: SP
* Minimum Relevant Experience: 5 Years
* Start Date: Immediate
* Location: Gurgaon, Hyderabad
* Work Timings: 12 PM to 9 PM IST or 7 AM – 3 PM.
* Key Skills: Patching / Vulnerability Remediation, Ansible / Ansible AWX, AWS, Terraform


Business Objective
  
  

To improve the stability and resilience of the platform by establishing more standardized vulnerability\-management and remediation processes.
  
  

The team is building out an Ansible\-based toolset for enterprise\-wide patching, with the intention of increasing automation and consistency across the environment.
  
  

The supporting JD confirms that the broader ICRE remit covers infrastructure reliability, security, resilience, vulnerability management, patch remediation and infrastructure automation across a 100% AWS\-based estate.
  
  

**Role Expectations:**  

* Join the existing team and become familiar with existing environment and processes.
* Take ownership of patching volumes and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Work as hands\-on engineers rather than in managerial or coordination roles.
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of Ansible playbooks and automation.
* Gradually expand their remit as they gain experience and understanding of the environment.
* Become part of the core foundation team, with patching as the immediate strategic focus.
* The role is therefore expected to grow over time rather than remain limited to routine patch execution.
* To develop and maintain Ansible AWX job templates, playbooks, roles, inventories and workflows to automate patching and remediation at scale.


**Candidate Profile Skills:**  

* Hands\-on engineers with approximately 5–8 years of experience.
* Priority Skills
* Patching experience is a must\-have. Candidates who can demonstrate actual enterprise patching and vulnerability\-remediation experience.
* The preferred technology stack includes:
* Patching / Vulnerability Remediation – Must Have
* Ansible / Ansible AWX
* AWS
* Terraform / Infrastructure\-as\-Code
* Linux and/or Windows infrastructure
* Automation and scripting
* Ability to participate effectively in technical stand\-ups and Agile ceremonies

* Candidates need to demonstrate real\-life situations where they have personally performed patching, vulnerability remediation and infrastructure automation.

We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Azure Cloud Architect** to lead the design and delivery of enterprise\-scale cloud platforms and next\-generation AI solutions. In this role, you will drive cloud transformation initiatives, architect innovative Azure\-based solutions, and provide technical leadership across complex modernization programs. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, presales teams, and engineering groups to shape scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectures.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect enterprise\-scale Azure cloud platforms and landing zones covering subscriptions, management groups, networking, identity, security, governance, monitoring, and automation
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available solutions using Azure services such as AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, API Management, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, and related PaaS services
* Define cloud\-native and application modernization strategies including re\-platforming, re\-architecting, containerization, microservices, and event\-driven architectures
* Provide architecture guidance for migration and modernization of large\-scale enterprise workloads to Azure
* Design and integrate Azure OpenAI and GenAI solutions including enterprise AI assistants, RAG\-based solutions, intelligent search, copilots, and AI\-enabled business applications
* Define patterns for integrating Azure OpenAI with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and knowledge repositories
* Ensure appropriate architecture around AI security, identity, data privacy, responsible AI, observability, and governance
* Lead architecture workshops and technical discussions with customers, application teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and senior stakeholders
* Develop reference architectures, architecture blueprints, design standards, and reusable cloud patterns
* Participate in RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, technical estimations, architecture presentations, and customer pitches
* Support presales teams in defining solution scope, architecture, delivery approach, effort estimates, assumptions, and technical risks
* Conduct architecture reviews, provide technical governance across cloud transformation programs, and mentor architects and engineering teams across multiple projects or workstreams

**AVP, Software Engineering — Practice Management \| LPL Technologies**

At LPL Financial Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**  

Practice Management is where the firm’s operating rhythm meets the advisor experience: onboarding advisors and practices, managing compensation, registrations, fees, and the workflows operations teams run every day. We are hiring an AVP of Engineering to lead a talented team modernizing this portfolio—raising quality, increasing velocity safely, and shipping capabilities that advisors and internal partners feel immediately.


If you want a high\-trust leadership seat with real technical depth—cloud\-native delivery, strong engineering discipline, and practical AI (not hype)—this is a standout opportunity at LPL.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Leadership**: Build, coach, and develop engineers; set a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and customer empathy. Hire and grow leaders.
* **Modernization**: Drive a pragmatic roadmap to improve architecture, reduce risk, retire debt, and migrate toward durable cloud patterns—without “big bang” disruption to the business.
* **Quality at scale**: Establish engineering standards for reliability, security, observability, testing, and operational readiness in business\-critical systems.
* **Cross\-functional partnership**: Work tightly with Product, Architecture, Platform, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders to prioritize outcomes, manage tradeoffs, and communicate clearly upward and outward.
* **AI, two ways:** For customers and operations: identify high\-value workflows (onboarding, exceptions, validations, investigations, decision support) where intelligent automation improves speed, accuracy, and auditability—within LPL governance. For engineering: accelerate delivery responsibly (design assistance, code/test/docs workflows) with standards that protect quality, security, and compliance.
* **What you will bring** (hands\-on to lead credibly) You are expected to be technically credible with complex enterprise systems—even as your primary job is leading the team. You should be comfortable diving into architecture reviews, critical incidents, and the hardest design decisions.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 10\+ years software engineering experience in enterprise environments; 5\+ years leading engineering teams (managers and senior ICs).
* Track record shipping and operating mission\-critical applications; experience in regulated / financial services strongly preferred.
* Strong Oracle PL/SQL engineering: packages, procedures, functions, triggers, bulk operations, and complex business logic in production.
* Strong SQL tuning and performance work: execution plans, indexing, AWR/ASH, partition strategy, production query optimization, process troubleshooting, and data flow analysis.
* Strong relational data modelling and operational data discipline;
* Demonstrated success leading modernization programs (incremental migration, platform patterns, service boundaries, strangler approaches) while keeping production stable.
* Ability to introduce AI\-enabled capabilities and/or AI\-accelerated engineering with measurable impact and appropriate controls.

**Core competencies:**

* A healthier technical foundation: clearer ownership, better observability, fewer repeat incidents, faster safe releases.
* A team that attracts and retains strong engineers—and ships modernization milestones on a credible cadence.
* A small set of high\-confidence AI wins (operations and/or product) with documented guardrails and measurable outcomes.
* **How you work** Systems thinking, decisive prioritization, calm under ambiguity, and executive\-ready communication. You raise the bar by clarifying standards, not by adding process for its own sake.

**Preferences:**

* Domain familiarity with advisor/practice onboarding, compensation, registration/licensing workflows, or fee/billing platforms.
* Experience with distributed systems, APIs, event\-driven patterns, and pragmatic microservices where they earn their complexity.
* Background shaping CI/CD, automated testing strategy, SRE practices, incident learning, and engineering metrics.
* Familiarity with model/workflow governance, monitoring, and responsible AI practices in enterprise settings.
* Experience with .NET / C\# and cloud\-native engineering on AWS (compute, data, messaging/integration, identity patterns, observability).
* Comfort with Python for automation, services, or data/AI\-adjacent workloads.
